blocks.title: Diffraction
blocks.text: Waves ka diffraction rukawaton ke tez kinaron ya konon ke gird waves ka mudna, ya kisi rukawat se aage waves ka phailna hai. Yeh tab hota hai jab wave kisi maddi rukawat ya surakh (slit) se mile jo wave ki wavelength ke qareeb size ka ho. Wavelength jitni lambi, phailao utna zyada, aur ulat.

blocks.alt: Rukawat mein ek jaisa gap, do khaake. Baen: qareeb qareeb seedhe wavefronts (chhoti wavelength) gap se guzar kar thora sa phailte hain: Small wavelength, Small diffraction. Daen: door door wavefronts (lambi wavelength) chaure aadhe daire bana kar phailte hain: Large wavelength, Large diffraction.
blocks.caption: Slit se diffraction (PDF page 157): chhoti wavelength, kam diffraction; lambi wavelength, zyada diffraction (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gap wahi hai, sirf wavelength badli hai. Jitni wavelength gap ke muqable mein lambi, utna lehar mur kar phailti hai. Isi liye awaz (lambi wavelength) darwaze ke gird mur jati hai magar roshni (bohat chhoti wavelength) nahi.

Diffraction mukhtalif qism ki waves mein dekha ja sakta hai, jin mein pani ki waves, sound waves, light waves aur electromagnetic waves shamil hain. Kuch misalein: konon ke gird ya darwaze se awaz sunna jahan se woh paida nahi hui, kyunke sound waves konon ke gird mudti hain; aur crystals se X-rays ka diffraction, kyunke atoms ki baqaida qataron ka faasla X-ray wavelength ke darje ka hai. Diffraction waves ke rawayye ka bunyadi pehlu hai jis ke bohat se amli istemalat hain.

Ripple tank (Fig. 7.11) bohat kaam ka aala hai, na sirf pani ki waves banane ke liye balke waves ki khusoosiyat jaise reflection, diffraction aur refraction dikhane ke liye bhi. Is mein pani, vibrator (maslan motor se jhoolti sui), rukawatein (maslan chhota mustateel block ya aadhi gol deewar) aur mukhtalif chaurai ke khalaa (gaps) hote hain; oopar laga lamp sheeshe ke pende wali tray ke neeche safed screen par wave pattern dalta hai. Vibrator hum-markaz (concentric) daire ya mutawazi waves banata hai, aur ek rukawat rakh kar muqarrar chaurai ka gap banaya jata hai; tajruba mukhtalif chaurai ke gaps se dohraya ja sakta hai. Dekha jata hai ke jab gap ki chaurai wavelength ke muqable chhoti ho to diffraction numayan hai aur waves rukawat ke gird mud kar aadhi gol shakal banati hain; jaise jaise gap wavelength ke muqable chaura hota hai diffraction kam hota hai aur waves kam mud kar gap se guzarti hain. Yeh gap ki chaurai ka diffraction par asar, aur gap ki chaurai aur wavelength ka taalluq waves ke rawayye par kaise asar karta hai, dikhata hai.

blocks.alt: Ripple tank: chaar tangon wale frame mein sheeshe ke tale wali pani ki tray. Stand ki lakri ki patiyon se elastic bands par latka vibrator pani ki satah ko chhoota hai. Stand par lagi lamp oopar se roshni dalti hai aur neeche farsh par safed screen par lehron ka pattern banta hai. blocks.caption: Figure 7.11: Ripple tank (kitab ki Figure 7.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Rukawat ke gap tak aate seedhe wavefronts, do khaake. Baen: tang gap, aage lehrein aadhe dairon mein phailti hain: Small gap, Increased diffraction. Daen: chaura gap, aage lehrein zyada tar seedhi, sirf kinaron par mudti hain: Large gap, Decreased diffraction.
blocks.caption: Tang gap, zyada diffraction; chaura gap, kam diffraction (kitab ki Figure 7.11 ke sath chhape khaakon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ripple tank mein lamp ki roshni lehron ke crests aur troughs ka saya neeche safed screen par dalti hai. Gap wavelength ke barabar ya chhota ho to lehrein khoob mudti hain (aadhe daire); gap bara ho to lehrein seedhi guzarti hain.

blocks.title: Example 7.6
blocks.text: Ripple tank mein wave generator 10 s mein 500 pulses paida karta hai. Pulses ki frequency nikalein. Hal: n = 500 pulses, t = 10 s, f = ?. T = t/n = 10 s/500 = 1/50 s; f = 1/T = 1/(1/50 s) = 50 s^-1, to f = 50 pulses fi second.

blocks.caption: Gap ki chaurai aur diffraction
rows: numayan diffraction; waves mud kar aadhi gol shakal mein phailti hain
thora diffraction; waves kam mud kar guzarti hain

blocks.text: Bareek diffraction grating se safed light ka diffraction use rangon mein phaila deta hai (For Your Information). Compact disc par bareek lakeerein (rulings), har ek 0.5 um chauri, diffraction grating ka kaam karti hain: jab chhota safed light ka source disc ko roshan kare to diffracted light rangeen raste banati hai jo lakeeron ke diffraction patterns ka majmooa hain (Interesting Information).

blocks.prompt: Waves ke diffraction se kya muraad hai, aur ripple tank kis maqsad ke liye istemal hota hai (short question 7.7; MCQ 7.11)? Hum kone ke peeche kisi ko sun kyun sakte hain magar dekh kyun nahi sakte?
blocks.explanation: Diffraction rukawaton ke gird waves ka mudna aur wavelength ke qareeb size ke surakhon se un ka phailna hai. Ripple tank pani ki waves banata hai aur reflection, refraction aur diffraction dikhata hai; mukhtalif chaurai ke gaps se dikhata hai ke tang gap waves ko khoob phailata hai aur chaura gap mushkil se. Sound ki wavelengths (centimetres se metres) darwazon aur konon ke qareeb hain, to sound un ke gird mudti hai, jabke light ki wavelengths (taqreeban 0.5 um) kahin chhoti hain, to light mushkil se mudti hai.

items: Diffraction: kinaron ke gird waves ka mudna aur wavelength ke qareeb surakhon se phailna; lambi wavelength, zyada phailao (konon ke gird sound, crystals se X-rays, gratings aur CDs se light).
Ripple tank (vibrator, pani, rukawatein, lamp, screen): chhota gap, tez diffraction; bara gap, thora. Example 7.6: 10 s mein 500 pulses, f = 50 Hz.
